# QYL0103: Duplicate instrumentation detected

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `OpenTelemetry` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0103DuplicateInstrumentationAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

When a method is instrumented by both auto-instrumentation (e.g., [Traced] attribute or interceptor) AND manual Activity.StartActivity spans, it creates duplicate nested spans that increase telemetry volume and can cause confusion in trace visualization. Choose one instrumentation approach per method.
